name: sales-call-per-store-pricing
description: Sales call transcript (plain text): the customer wants per-store pricing with an express tier, Singapore hosting, and has a pipe-delimited POS export.

input.chunk:
Mira: Thanks for making time, Daniel. How did the pilot go in the three stores?
Daniel: Good. The store managers like the shelf reports. My problem is the pricing. A flat fee for the whole chain doesn't work for us, because our stores are very different sizes. The Riverside store is four times the floor area of the express ones.
Mira: So you'd want it per store?
Daniel: Per store, yes, with a lower rate for express formats. We have 42 stores, 17 of them express. If it's per store I can start with the 25 full-size ones and get budget signed this quarter.
Mira: That's workable. I can't confirm numbers on this call, but I'll send a per-store proposal with two tiers by next Tuesday.
Daniel: Fine. One more thing, procurement will ask whether data stays in the region. Everything has to be hosted in Singapore.
Mira: It can be. I'll put that in writing too.
Daniel: And who do I talk to about the POS export? Our IT lead, Priya, says the nightly file is pipe-delimited, not CSV.
Mira: That's fine, we handle pipe-delimited already. I'll connect Priya with our engineer.
Daniel: Great. Enjoy the rest of your day.
